title: His brother's drum set and changing his own drums
summary: Discussion of the drums he learned on; his brother kept the same set while he changed drums often.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Yeah. I don't believe he'd know. Is this the set of drums you learned on, you think? That same little, looks like a wooden... It could've been. It could've been. You were telling about...
Because he... I changed drums plenty, but he didn't.
Yeah, he kept the same one.
